capabilities: Clip webpages into the vault as Markdown with title, content, and metadata
Browse web pages in a built-in webview
Organize clips into categories and filter by them
Process clipped content with custom Gemini AI prompts
extras: Can be installed via BRAT for beta testing. AI features require a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save web articles into the vault or browse pages without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: AI Processing: Transform and analyze content using Google's Gemini AI

summary: Web clipper that saves webpages as Markdown files and browses the web inside Obsidian, with category organization and optional Gemini AI processing.
